mapper.select:
select pi.id, pi.instance_code as code, pi.instance_name as name, pp.plugin_code as package_code, pp.plugin_name as package_name, pc.capability_code, pc.extension_point, pc.stage_code, pp.version, pi.status, pi.timeout_ms, pi.config_json from kb_plugin_instances pi inner join kb_plugin_packages pp on pp.plugin_code = pi.plugin_code inner join kb_plugin_capabilities pc on pc.id = pi.capability_id
and ( pi.instance_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or pi.instance_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or pp.plugin_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or pc.capability_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and pi.status = #{status}
order by pi.id desc

select pi.id, pi.instance_code as code, pi.instance_name as name, pp.plugin_code as package_code, pp.plugin_name as package_name, pc.capability_code, pc.extension_point, pc.stage_code, pp.version, pi.status, pi.timeout_ms, pi.config_json from kb_plugin_instances pi inner join kb_plugin_packages pp on pp.plugin_code = pi.plugin_code inner join kb_plugin_capabilities pc on pc.id = pi.capability_id where pi.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into kb_plugin_instances( plugin_code, capability_id, instance_code, instance_name, config_json, status, timeout_ms, concurrency_limit ) values( #{packageCode}, (select pc.id from kb_plugin_capabilities pc where pc.plugin_code = #{packageCode} and pc.capability_code = #{capabilityCode} limit 1), #{code}, #{name}, #{configJson}, #{status}, #{timeoutMs}, 0 )
mapper.select: select pb.id, pb.instance_code, pi.instance_name, pp.plugin_code as package_code, pp.plugin_name as package_name, pc.capability_code, pc.extension_point, pb.stage_code, pb.scope_type, pb.scope_ref_id, pb.order_no, pb.status, coalesce(pb.binding_config_json, pi.config_json) as config_json, pi.timeout_ms from kb_plugin_bindings pb inner join kb_plugin_instances pi on pi.instance_code = pb.instance_code inner join kb_plugin_packages pp on pp.plugin_code = pi.plugin_code inner join kb_plugin_capabilities pc on pc.id = pi.capability_id where pb.status = 1 and pi.status = 1 and pp.status = 1 and pc.status = 1 and pc.extension_point = #{extensionPoint} and pb.stage_code = #{stageCode} order by pb.order_no asc, pb.id asc
